articles.summary: MVB Financial Corp. (NASDAQ: MVBF) (“MVB Financial,” “MVB” or the “Company”), the holding company for MVB Bank, Inc. (“MVB Bank”), today announced that it will participate in the TD Cowen Financials Fintech Conference, taking place November 17-18, 2026, at the Lotte New York Palace. Larry F. Mazza, Chief Executive Officer and President, and Michael Sumbs, Chief Financial Officer, will attend and be available for one-on-one investor meetings throughout the conference. Larry will also participate in the panel discussion “AI Adoption Technology Initiatives” on Wednesday, November 18, from 8 to 8:35 a.m. ET. About MVB Financial Corp. MVB Financial Corp. (Nasdaq: MVBF) is an innovative bank powering Fintech solutions in payments, card issuance and online gaming programs for leading Fintech companies nationwide, while providing traditional retail and commercial banking services within established markets.
